description: A fundamental with three further oscillators added to it, each tuned as an interval above the first and given its own level, with a choice of waveform.

params.text: How much the FQ jack moves the pitch. With nothing patched into FQ this knob is a fine tune instead.
How far the first added oscillator is tuned above the fundamental.
Level of the first added oscillator.
How far the second added oscillator is tuned above the fundamental.
Level of the second added oscillator.
How far the third added oscillator is tuned above the fundamental.
Level of the third added oscillator.
Chooses the waveform all four oscillators use: up a sine, middle a saw, down a square.

inputs.text: Sets the pitch of the fundamental at one volt per octave; the added oscillators follow it.
Moves the pitch, by as much as the MOD knob allows.

outputs.text: The three added oscillators alone, with the fundamental left out.
The fundamental and the three added oscillators mixed together.

notes: Set Rack's sample rate to 96kHz before using this module. At any other rate it runs at the wrong speed, and a red bar appears across the bottom of the panel saying so.

inputs.0: 1V per octave · continuous · one channel only
inputs.1:
1V per octave · continuous · one channel only
